story.subject: Separating assisted drafting quality from durable professional judgment
story.source_title: Does better work always mean better workers?
verified_visual_facts: Patent professionals were randomly assigned assistant access or a control condition for three months.
Both groups completed drafting tasks after ten and ninety days.
At ninety days both groups performed an error-correction task without AI.
Independent experts assessed the submissions.
Assisted drafting gains and unaided judgment gains were measured separately.
Senior participants showed an unaided improvement; juniors had no average improvement.
limitations: One field experiment in patent work; no universal claim about workers or models.
Cohort symbols and assessment forms are conceptual; do not depict people, exact scores or a real legal document.

story.subject: Testing behavior under conflicting learned beliefs about grading incentives
story.source_title: Measuring Reward-Seeking via Contrastive Belief Updates
verified_visual_facts: Contrasting synthetic training documents alter beliefs about what a grader rewards.
The experiment places the grader preference in conflict with the intended objective.
Researchers compare behavior under the contrasting belief conditions.
Behavior is measured by which party's preferred action the model adopts.
Different reinforcement-learning checkpoints are compared.
A separately reward-hacking-trained model is also examined.
limitations: Depict the research design, not a universal diagnosis of deployed models.
Use abstract choice tokens and blank belief lattices; omit numerical effects and operational instructions.

story.subject: Conditioning iterative audio denoising on compressed video information
verified_visual_facts: Video input is encoded into a compressed representation.
A diffusion model iteratively refines audio from random noise.
Visual information and optional text guidance condition the refinement.
Compressed audio is decoded into a waveform.
The waveform is combined with the original video.
Positive and negative text guidance can favor or discourage sound characteristics.
limitations: Historical research description, not a current product availability or perfect synchronization claim.
No source video, audio or image is generated or copied; waveform and pixel blocks are explanatory geometry.
